content.text: Updated (528 chars)

Root cause is now clear: bare frontmatter is pre-wrapped as fenced YAML before pulldown-cmark sees it, but `wrap_bare_frontmatter()` currently “cleans” the header by dropping every line that starts with a space. That silently deletes indented YAML sequence entries:

```yaml
depends:
  - foo
```

becomes:

```yaml
depends:
```

So `serde_yaml` parses `depends` as null, and `--meta depends=foo` has nothing to match. Fenced frontmatter bypasses this wrapper, which is why it works there.

content.text:
Diagnosed and fixed.

## Root cause

Bare frontmatter is parsed by `wrap_bare_frontmatter()` in `crates/liwe/src/markdown.rs`, which wraps the leading bare header block in `---` fences so pulldown-cmark parses it as YAML metadata.

The broken working-tree version was “cleaning” the bare header by dropping every line beginning with a space:

```rust
.filter(|l| !l.starts_with(' '))
```

That corrupts valid YAML sequences:

```yaml
title: Task A
depends:
  - foo
  - bar
```

became effectively:

```yaml
title: Task A
depends:
```

So `serde_yaml` parsed `depends` as null, and `iwe find --meta depends=foo` didn’t match.

Fenced YAML worked because it bypassed `wrap_bare_frontmatter()` and preserved the sequence indentation.

## Fix

Restored `wrap_bare_frontmatter()` to preserve the header exactly when wrapping:

```rust
Cow::Owned(format!("---\n{}\n---\n\n{}", header, rest))
```

That code now preserves YAML indentation, so bare metadata sequences survive parsing.

Note: this code restoration matches `HEAD`, so the current tracked diff does **not** show a `markdown.rs` change. The working tree had an uncommitted broken version at start; reverting that was the code fix.

## Regression test added

Added `value_in_bare_yaml_sequence_matches` to:

```text
crates/liwe/tests/find_metadata_test.rs
```

It verifies:

```yaml
title: Task A
depends:
  - foo
  - bar
```

with `bare_frontmatter: true` matches:

```text
--meta depends=foo
```

## Verification

Ran:

```text
cargo test -p liwe value_in_bare_yaml_sequence_matches -- --nocapture
cargo test
```

Both passed.

